function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.reasoning: The user wants to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "有哪些材料選擇？" They want to know what materials are available. According to the system message, we can only respond with function calls or refusal. We cannot provide normal text. But the user is asking about options. We could interpret this as a request for information. However, the system says we can only respond with function calls or refusal. So we need to respond with a function call. But the user didn't explicitly request an order. They just asked about material choices. We might interpret that they want to order a custom sculpture. The user said: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" That means "I want to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. What material options are there?" Actually, they specifically say "青銅雕塑" which is bronze. So they want a bronze sculpture. They ask "有哪些材料選擇？" That seems contradictory because they already specified bronze. Maybe they want to know all possible materials? But the user specifically said "青銅雕塑". So we should interpret that they want to order a bronze sculpture. The user didn't specify size. So we can use default size 12. So we should call the function sculpture_create_custom with item="horse", material="Bronze", size=12.
